en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a broad square with horse‑drawn carriages in front of a long, two‑storey barracks‑like building with a towered roof. Smaller townhouses and a defensive tower are visible in the background. The front text identifies the view as Hermannnsplatz with the imperial and royal infantry barracks and sends greetings from Hermannstadt. The back has printed lines for address and the Hungarian heading "Levelező-Lap."
